main_measure.name: mean excess 3-day return after Sunday bars with forecast > 0
main_measure.threshold: t >= 2 with slope > 0 (confirm), t <= -2 (reject), on at least 100 cases

supporting_check.name: OLS slope of excess 3-day return on forecast

decided_by: Mean excess 3-day return positive with t >= 2 on at least 100 cases and a positive slope.
reading: A Sunday bar is one whose next calendar day is a Monday (UTC), a case needs close[t+3] in the same window, and the coin's mean 3-day return is taken on the non-overlapping grid 0, 3, 6, ... of all its windows pooled; fewer than 100 cases is reported as not observable.
